up: Retrieve IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against human B-Raf kinase. For each activity, return: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_value (IC50 in nM), standard_relation, pubmed_id_or_doi (use pubmed_id if available, else doi). Join activities with compound_structures for SMILES, docs for literature references, and filter by target 'B-Raf' in Homo sapiens via target_dictionary. Ensure only IC50 measurements with standard_units = 'nM' are included. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name LIKE '%B-Raf%' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
